requirements: all model states and grids identified
baseline_identity.on_failure: resolve provenance or create new declared baseline; no silent substitution

requirements: component total and free directional masses separately reconciled
zero-wind modal state separated from wind/pre-damaged states
mass_and_state_contract.on_failure: block dependent dynamics until identity is resolved

eigen_quality.on_failure: exclude failed solve; do not perturb mass

modal_subspace.on_failure: frequency-only or declared output-limited result; trigger bounded N06 if necessary

requirements: same physical wind field remapped per mesh
no double equivalent and explicit cable loads
load_mapping.on_failure: correct load mapping before any coupled result admission

static_truncation.near_zero_policy: freeze absolute scales before trial; report absolute and relative errors
static_truncation.on_failure: limit output scope or request bounded basis expansion

requirements: actual element flags and node/region coverage
TMQ zeta distinct from viscous damping
damping_design.on_failure: do not claim actual damping from coefficient formula alone

response_mesh.on_failure: mesh-sensitive scope; no unconditional grid convergence

frequency_response.on_failure: limit band/outputs or extend basis within budget

requirements: identical continuous forcing under dt refinement
independent A then B agrees with B alone
rollback and failure records remain distinct
time_and_isolation.on_failure: correct integration contract before tower pilot

dynamic_balance.threshold_rule: max(absolute_floor, relative_scale_factor * declared max term magnitude)
dynamic_balance.on_failure: reject affected dynamic records; never substitute static equilibrium

requirements: no state transition under zero perturbation

free_decay.damping_error_rule: absolute difference <= max(0.001, 0.10 * target damping ratio)
free_decay.on_failure: revisit actual damping participation and excitation

linear_energy.scope: analytic/linear fixed-tangent benchmark only with full storage and work terms
linear_energy.near_zero_policy: freeze absolute energy scale before run; no division by near zero
linear_energy.nonlinear_missing_energy: null with reason; no invented balance pass
linear_energy.on_failure: diagnose time integration or ledger; do not generalize this gate to nonlinear TMQ

requirements: seed and shared latent spatial field saved
full-square or linearized aerodynamic law stated
wind_field.on_failure: keep coherent toy input as integration test only

elastic_pilot.statistics_status: short pilot, not extreme-value or failure-probability evidence
elastic_pilot.on_failure: bounded amplitude reduction or classify outside elastic pilot

time_convergence.on_failure: report dt sensitivity; no automatic unbounded dt halving

requirements: reference source or explicit assumption per parameter
line sag-tension compatibility and boundary scope
aerodynamic parameter version separate from prototype
physical_inputs.on_failure: conditional model only; no design wind-speed claim

requirements: same imperfection function and boundary while refining
reference_convergence.on_failure: do not calibrate equivalent model to unconverged reference

material_recoverability.scope: reference verified elastic fibers; corresponding displacement/force controlled protocols separately
material_recoverability.on_failure: mechanism mismatch; do not fix by relabeling geometric elasticity as plasticity

material_holdout.on_failure: limit member/path scope, choose hybrid/reference route, or stop physical generalization

requirements: first unstable group and response mechanism compared
numerical_reference_only is not independent physical validation
panel_validation.on_failure: single-member pass does not license whole-tower nonlinear interpretation

requirements: declining sampled path distinguished from stable continuous branch
pushover_convergence.on_failure: sampled peak or partial path only; do not assign collapse

requirements: last accepted state separated from failed attempts
all comparisons only over common completed domain
local record links for each published event
event_traceability.on_failure: limit rankings to actual observed coverage

physical_sensitivity.on_failure: retain model-dependent intervals; no cherry-picked single estimate

requirements: key member actual states mapped to material_validity_scope; uncovered nonlinear state is out_of_scope
damping effect and dynamic balance reported
no statistical collapse claim from few runs
nonlinear_admission.on_failure: restricted exploratory output or no nonlinear run; formal gate remains closed

requirements: defined unloading history with gravity and material memory
nonpositive eigenvalues reported as stability evidence
no automatic reset to virgin model
residual_modal.on_failure: not_applicable or unstable residual state, no normal modal animation

fragility_admission.on_failure: response statistics only or defer fitting

requirements: case/model/state and assumptions next to charts
display scale distinct from physical amplitude
publication.on_failure: do not label unverified publication as verified analysis

requirements: all selected tasks assessed, not necessarily passed
scope_closeout.on_failure: deliver partial assessed scope with exact outstanding items
